Content.value:
"# Emotion Controller
Presentation-layer emotion state.

Emotion: discrete emotion enum from Constants.
EmotionIntensity: reserved 0..1 strength value.
EmotionSerial: reserved update/version counter for the future DesktopButler Runtime.

Sensory is intentionally deferred until the presentation framework is stable."

"# Timeline Segment Tone ingress
Consumes the logical Segment Tone released by Link Timeline as one input to the local Emotion Controller.

Local policy (first version): neutral=0, happy=1, angry=2, sad=3. Intensity is intentionally not consumed yet.
Unknown/custom tone keys preserve the current Emotion. Tone remains an Adapter fact; this controller maps it to local presentation state."

Content.value:
"# Expression Controller
Central face-state resolver and presenter.
Priority: INTERACTION > REQUESTED > BASE.

BASE uses the shared presentation-style values directly: Emotion 0..4 maps to None / Joy / Angry / Sorrow / Fun.
Do not add a second base-expression switch while those stable values remain aligned.

Interaction and Requested fields remain serial-committed. CandidateExpression and ExpressionSerial are presentation guards:
- hidden lower-priority updates do not replay the visible expression;
- same-payload source serial changes are presentation-neutral;
- graph enable forces one controlled resynchronization.

InteractionExpressionSource remains owner-bound and is cleaned by Interaction Controller.
Style and InteractionPhase stay orthogonal; concrete interactions consume them only when real presentation variants exist.
Native Lip Sync remains an independent mouth overlay."

Content.value:
"# Base Animation Owner
0 = NONE
1 = LOCOMOTION
2 = BACK_DRAG

Actions may take ownership when they start. They release only if they are still the current owner.
Idle Controller is allowed to drive the base idle animation only while owner == NONE."

Content.value:
"# 单次挥手 / performance.wave_once
保留已选择的挥手动画；本地 WaveDurationSeconds=2.5 秒后收尾，可按听感/画面调整，不声称自动读取动画时长。
空闲 BaseAnimationOwner=0 且 InteractionOwner=0 才执行；重复/忙碌事件不排队。占用本图 WaveOwnerId=3。
专用隐藏变换时钟计时，结束或禁用只在仍持有本图所有权时释放；Idle Controller 按当前 Emotion 恢复，不夺回移动/拖拽动画。
message 仅保留为说明。受理不等于完成；本动作不发送业务回执。"

Content.value:
"# 惊讶 / expression.surprised
Director event -> local Emotion variant -> REQUESTED only. Defaults use verified native brow/eye resources; five variant variables initially map to the same base expression and can be changed independently. DurationSeconds is clamped to 0.1..10 s.
Payload, duration and active are set before serial commit. The private native clock expires only the request serial still owned by this graph; an old timer/disable cannot clear a newer expression. Repeats refresh duration without forcing same-payload replay.
INTERACTION > REQUESTED > BASE remains in Expression Controller. Expiry clears REQUESTED and resolves the current base/interaction, not an old snapshot. No custom mouth/Lip Sync. No automatic business completion receipt."

Content.value:
"# 疑惑 / expression.confused
Director event -> local Emotion variant -> REQUESTED only. Defaults use verified native brow/eye resources; five variant variables initially map to the same base expression and can be changed independently. DurationSeconds is clamped to 0.1..10 s.
Payload, duration and active are set before serial commit. The private native clock expires only the request serial still owned by this graph; an old timer/disable cannot clear a newer expression. Repeats refresh duration without forcing same-payload replay.
INTERACTION > REQUESTED > BASE remains in Expression Controller. Expiry clears REQUESTED and resolves the current base/interaction, not an old snapshot. No custom mouth/Lip Sync. No automatic business completion receipt."

Content.value:
"# Gaze Controller
Resolves one gaze mode and owns the Character Look At seam.

Priority: INTERACTION > ACT MODE BASE.
- STANDBY: EnableLookCursor toggles CAMERA / CURSOR.
- FREE: FreeLookAtCamera selects CAMERA / ANIMATION.
- InteractionGazeMode: -1 inherits base; 0 animation; 1 Camera 1; 2 cursor.

ANIMATION disables Character Look At. CAMERA follows the Camera 1 position through Look-at Camera Anchor.
CURSOR follows Look-at Cursor Anchor. Interactions declare their override in their own owner commit/release chains."

Content.value: "# Cursor Track Switch\nEnables/disables cursor tracking assets in response to the shared cursor-tracking state.\nThis graph is a routing/switch layer and does not define interaction behavior itself."

"# Character Transform\nSynchronizes the composed helper-node transform stack into the final character transform.\nOther behavior graphs should move/rotate the helper nodes rather than fighting over the character transform directly."

"# 无语 / expression.speechless
Director event -> local Emotion variant -> REQUESTED only. Defaults use verified native brow/eye resources; five variant variables initially map to the same base expression and can be changed independently. DurationSeconds is clamped to 0.1..10 s.
Payload, duration and active are set before serial commit. The private native clock expires only the request serial still owned by this graph; an old timer/disable cannot clear a newer expression. Repeats refresh duration without forcing same-payload replay.
INTERACTION > REQUESTED > BASE remains in Expression Controller. Expiry clears REQUESTED and resolves the current base/interaction, not an old snapshot. No custom mouth/Lip Sync. No automatic business completion receipt."

Content.value:
"# 害羞 / expression.embarrassed
Director event -> local Emotion variant -> REQUESTED only. Defaults use verified native brow/eye resources; five variant variables initially map to the same base expression and can be changed independently. DurationSeconds is clamped to 0.1..10 s.
Payload, duration and active are set before serial commit. The private native clock expires only the request serial still owned by this graph; an old timer/disable cannot clear a newer expression. Repeats refresh duration without forcing same-payload replay.
INTERACTION > REQUESTED > BASE remains in Expression Controller. Expiry clears REQUESTED and resolves the current base/interaction, not an old snapshot. No custom mouth/Lip Sync. No automatic business completion receipt."

Content.value: "# Cursor Movement\nPropagates the current cursor position into the cursor scene assets.\nThis graph is presentation/position plumbing; mouse-to-world conversion is handled elsewhere."

"# Interaction Controller v9 - Data-Driven Phase Clock

InteractionOwner remains the single interaction lifecycle truth.

Important design rule:
- local Warudo interactions acquire/release InteractionOwner synchronously in their own graph
- do NOT route local acquire/release through an asynchronous request-serial seam
- concrete interactions keep only the minimal owner guard needed to avoid stealing/releasing another interaction

Centralized owner-bound InteractionExpression cleanup:
- whenever InteractionOwner changes, an active InteractionExpression whose Source no longer matches the new owner is cleared
- an inactive stale Source is also cleared
- this removes duplicated expression-release guards from Contact graphs
- direct X→Y owner transfer is treated as exceptional but stale expression state is still cleaned safely

Phase behavior:
- InteractionSerial increments on every owner change and is the interaction generation
- InteractionPhase: 0 = NONE; a non-empty InteractionPhasePoints list starts an active interaction at 1
- InteractionPhasePoints accepts any number of non-negative, strictly increasing millisecond thresholds
- the hidden linear Phase Clock and ON_UPDATE advance one threshold per frame until caught up
- threshold values are read dynamically; the clock scale is established when the interaction starts

Presentation axes:
- Emotion values 0..4 are the shared presentation Style axis.
- InteractionPhase is the independent local time axis.
- Concrete interactions may consume Style × Phase only when a real animation/pose/expression variant exists; no empty global matrix is maintained here.
Gaze seam:
- InteractionGazeMode is a transient owner-scoped presentation override.
- -1 inherits the current ActMode base gaze; 0 uses animation; 1 looks at Camera 1; 2 follows the cursor.
- Every InteractionOwner acquisition/release path commits gaze mode before owner state, preventing stale overrides."

Content.value:
"# Back Drag
Handles dragging the character from the back contact target.
Acquires InteractionOwner/BaseAnimationOwner, follows cursor movement while dragging, and releases only the ownership it still holds.

# Interaction lifecycle cleanup
Local `Playing` state has been removed. Interaction activity is derived from authoritative shared state instead of cached per-graph booleans. Continuous execution must read `InteractionOwner`, the relevant target state, and any necessary local fact such as `IsDragging` directly.
Continuous gate: (InteractionOwner == BACK_DRAG) AND (DragTarget == BACK) AND IsDragging.

WarudoDC phase events:
- Back Drag commits [3000, 15000, 30000] before InteractionOwner acquisition.
- Phase 2/3/4 emit separate Control events after confirming Back Drag still owns the interaction.
- Adapter may bind one independent LLM hook to each event."

Content.value:
"# Autonomy Controller — Bounds / Failsafe
Owns autonomous target policy, never direct transform execution.

Autonomy request: RequestedTarget + RequestSerial → clamp to Soft Bounds → existing Locomotion request seam.
Requests are accepted only in FREE mode, with no local Interaction owner and no pending FREE exit.

Hard Failsafe observes Character Node 0. It acts only when no Interaction owns the character and Locomotion is idle.
An out-of-bounds character is returned through Locomotion to the nearest point inside Hard Bounds.
It does not change ActMode, Expression state or Interaction state.

Soft/Hard bounds and comparison epsilon are stable world-space scene constants owned by Constants.
Current values are conservative initial defaults and must be tuned in the real desktop layout before freezing."

Content.value: "# Mouse Click Ray Probe\nPositions/orients the click probe from the current cursor and activates it according to mouse input / ActMode.\nThe probe supplies contact events to click/poke-style interactions."

"# Hand Drag v3
Fixes anchor coordinate mapping.
The IK anchor is now unparented/world-space, so Camera rotation no longer flips or lifts the target.
On hand acquisition: DragOffset = Contact.Position - (RawCursorWorld * DepthScale).
During drag: Anchor = (RawCursorWorld * DepthScale) + DragOffset.
This mirrors the already-working Back Drag projection model and preserves the grabbed hand's initial world position.
IK activation/release behavior from v2 is unchanged.

# Interaction lifecycle cleanup
Local `Playing` state has been removed. Interaction activity is derived from authoritative shared state instead of cached per-graph booleans. Continuous execution must read `InteractionOwner`, the relevant target state, and any necessary local fact such as `IsDragging` directly.
Continuous gate: (InteractionOwner == HAND_DRAG) AND IsDragging AND ((DragTarget == LEFT_HAND) OR (DragTarget == RIGHT_HAND)).

# Interaction owner rule
Acquire/release remains synchronous and owner-guarded locally. This is intentional: Drag/Rotate setup and cleanup are event-local and must not depend on an asynchronous request serial.

# WarudoDC phase events
Commits [3000,15000,30000] before owner acquisition. Phase 2/3/4 emit independent Control events only while INTERACTION_HAND_DRAG owns the interaction. duration_ms is the phase threshold. Default semantic: ordinary hand holding, not forceful pulling. Both hand acquisition paths configure the phase clock. Existing movement/IK, rotation and release remain unchanged."

Content.value:
"# Idle Controller
Single entry point for base Idle presentation.

Re-evaluates on graph enable, BaseAnimationOwner changes, or Emotion changes.
If owner != NONE, it does nothing.
Only Neutral has a dedicated clip in this stage; all other emotions currently fall back to Neutral.

Control action `idle.return_normal_pose` re-enters the same owner guard and Emotion switch.
It is intended for Director cleanup_cues; it does not bypass active base-animation ownership."

"# Locomotion Controller
Owns request/runtime variables only.
Request → reset internal stage → choose RISE / FALL / HORIZONTAL.
Vertical staging is controlled explicitly by `UseVerticalStages`; Rise/Fall timing comes from `RiseSpeed` / `FallSpeed`.
Turn timing is angle-based: `TurnDuration = max(TurnAngle / TurnSpeed, MinTurnDuration)`."

"### HorizontalStage
0 = TURN_TO_MOVE
1 = MOVE
2 = TURN_TO_ARRIVAL"

"### Style Resolution
`Style = AUTO (-1)` follows current `Emotion` in real time.
Style values 0..4 intentionally match Emotion values.
Explicit Style overrides Emotion.
Only Move consumes ResolvedStyle for now."

Content.value:
"# Halo Rotate
Dragging the halo rotates Character Node 0 around Y using horizontal cursor delta.
Uses DragTarget and InteractionOwner so halo rotation cannot overlap incompatible interactions.

# Interaction lifecycle cleanup
Local `Playing` state has been removed. Interaction activity is derived from authoritative shared state instead of cached per-graph booleans. Continuous execution must read `InteractionOwner`, the relevant target state, and any necessary local fact such as `IsDragging` directly.
Continuous gate: (InteractionOwner == HALO_ROTATE) AND (DragTarget == HALO) AND IsDragging.

# Interaction owner rule
Acquire/release remains synchronous and owner-guarded locally. This is intentional: Drag/Rotate setup and cleanup are event-local and must not depend on an asynchronous request serial.

# WarudoDC phase events
Commits [3000,15000,30000] before owner acquisition. Phase 2/3/4 emit independent Control events only while HALO_ROTATE owns the interaction. duration_ms is the phase threshold, not rotation angle or turns. Rotation and release remain synchronous and unchanged."

Content.value:
"# Contact Forehead - synchronous Contact template

Minimal Contact lifecycle:
1. OnEnter: if InteractionOwner == NONE, synchronously set owner to INTERACTION_CONTACT_FOREHEAD.
2. Immediately submit InteractionExpression = EXPRESSION_FOREHEAD_CONTACT (Source + payload + Active, Serial last).
3. OnExit / graph disable: only if InteractionOwner still equals this Contact, set InteractionOwner = NONE.
4. Interaction Controller centrally clears stale owner-bound InteractionExpression when owner changes.

No local Playing cache and no asynchronous acquire/release request seam.
The only local state guard retained is the owner check required to prevent stealing/releasing another interaction.


WarudoDC Contact settlement:
- commits [600, 2000] before acquiring InteractionOwner
- ending while Phase == 2 emits interaction.contact_forehead.touch once
- entering Phase 3 while this Contact still owns the interaction emits interaction.contact_forehead.stroke once
- Phase 1 exits and Phase 3+ exits do not emit a touch event
- ending in Phase 3 emits interaction.contact_forehead.stroke.cancel; reply_to is this interaction's stroke.EventId; submitted/rejected both continue cleanup"

"# Vertical
RISE → Jump + Position Tween → FALL
FALL → Fall + Position Tween → Land → behavior hold (`LandDuration`) → HORIZONTAL
Phase exits are driven by behavior `OnTransitionEnd`, never animation transition completion."

"# Drag Target State\nMaintains the currently captured drag target and clears it on release / incompatible mode changes.\nDragTarget identifies what is being dragged; it is intentionally separate from InteractionOwner."

Content.value:
"# Locomotion Turn
**Horizontal sequence: TURN_TO_MOVE → MOVE → TURN_TO_ARRIVAL**
This graph owns both turn stages. Rotation `OnTransitionEnd` is the phase clock; animation transition never controls flow.
Turn rotation uses an InOutSine S-curve.
`TransitionTime = max(shortestYawAngle / TurnSpeed, MinTurnDuration)`."
"### TURN 1\nFace from current point toward TargetPosition before moving.\nIf already within ArrivalDistance, skip MOVE; optionally SnapOnArrival, then continue directly to TURN_TO_ARRIVAL."
"### TURN 2\nAfter MOVE, turn to ArrivalYaw (or KEEP current facing)."

"### Shared shortest-yaw resolver
raw = DesiredYaw - CurrentYaw
raw ≥ 180 → LEFT wrap; -raw ≥ 180 → RIGHT wrap; otherwise sign(raw) decides.
The same resolved shortest angle also drives TurnDuration through TurnSpeed."

"# autonomy.rotate_to(yaw: Float)
水平转向（度）。to 限制到 [0,360]；by 限制到 [-180,180]，按现有 Locomotion 最短角路径转向。
复制 AutonomyEnabled / FREE / 无 Interaction / 无 FreeExitPending 守卫。位置保持请求接收时的当前位置，不执行移动或软边界夹取。
先写 TargetPosition/ArrivalYaw/模式，最后提交 Locomotion.RequestSerial。转向由原 Locomotion Turn 执行，复用速度和 easing。
使旧移动回执失效；仅 Arrived 且本图活动 Locomotion serial 匹配时发送 .result(status=completed,rotation=实际世界欧拉角)，reply_to 指向原事件。忙碌拒绝、被替代不伪报完成，沿用原工具的 execution_unknown 超时边界。"

1. OnEnter: if InteractionOwner == NONE, synchronously set owner to INTERACTION_CONTACT_NOSE.
2. Immediately submit InteractionExpression = EXPRESSION_NOSE_CONTACT (Source + payload + Active, Serial last).
3. OnExit / graph disable: only if InteractionOwner still equals this Contact, set InteractionOwner = NONE.
4. Interaction Controller centrally clears stale owner-bound InteractionExpression when owner changes.

No local Playing cache and no asynchronous acquire/release request seam.
The only local state guard retained is the owner check required to prevent stealing/releasing another interaction.


WarudoDC Contact settlement:
- commits [600, 2000] before acquiring InteractionOwner
- ending while Phase == 2 emits interaction.contact_nose.touch once
- entering Phase 3 while this Contact still owns the interaction emits interaction.contact_nose.stroke once
- Phase 1 exits and Phase 3+ exits do not emit a touch event
- ending in Phase 3 emits interaction.contact_nose.stroke.cancel; reply_to is the EventId of this interaction's stroke event"

"# Contact Breast
Phase-free contact placeholder. Left/right receiver spheres are attached to Chest. Submits BreastPoke via InteractionExpression.

WarudoDC Contact settlement:
- commits [600, 2000] before acquiring InteractionOwner
- ending while Phase == 2 emits interaction.contact_breast.touch once
- entering Phase 3 while this Contact still owns the interaction emits interaction.contact_breast.stroke once
- Phase 1 exits and Phase 3+ exits do not emit a touch event
- ending in Phase 3 emits interaction.contact_breast.stroke.cancel; reply_to is this interaction's stroke.EventId; submitted/rejected both continue cleanup"

"# autonomy.rotate_by(delta_yaw: Float)
水平转向（度）。to 限制到 [0,360]；by 限制到 [-180,180]，按现有 Locomotion 最短角路径转向。
复制 AutonomyEnabled / FREE / 无 Interaction / 无 FreeExitPending 守卫。位置保持请求接收时的当前位置，不执行移动或软边界夹取。
先写 TargetPosition/ArrivalYaw/模式，最后提交 Locomotion.RequestSerial。转向由原 Locomotion Turn 执行，复用速度和 easing。
使旧移动回执失效；仅 Arrived 且本图活动 Locomotion serial 匹配时发送 .result(status=completed,rotation=实际世界欧拉角)，reply_to 指向原事件。忙碌拒绝、被替代不伪报完成，沿用原工具的 execution_unknown 超时边界。"

Content.value:
"# Locomotion Move
Translation + style-aware loop animation.
Entry: `HorizontalStage = MOVE`
Exit: Position `OnTransitionEnd` → `TURN_TO_ARRIVAL`
Move remains Linear so `Distance / MoveSpeed` represents constant world speed.
Only Move consumes `ResolvedStyle`; Turn / Vertical stay Neutral and do not touch expressions."
"### Gait resolution → MoveAnimationSerial → Position\nAnimation is dispatched separately so a Style change never restarts the position tween."

"### Move Style Animation Dispatcher
Only `Locomotion Move` is Style-aware.
Triggers on move start and whenever `ResolvedStyle` changes during MOVE.
Turn / Vertical remain Neutral-only and never touch expressions.
Non-neutral nodes currently duplicate Neutral resources as replaceable slots."

"### Style slot order
0 Neutral
1 Happy
2 Angry
3 Sad
4 Embarrassed

Non-neutral slots intentionally start with the Neutral Walk/Run clips. Replace each PLAY node later. Unknown styles use the Neutral default branch."

Content.value:
"# Contact Belly
Phase-free contact placeholder. Receiver is attached to Spine. Submits BellyPoke via InteractionExpression.

WarudoDC Contact settlement:
- commits [600, 2000] before acquiring InteractionOwner
- ending while Phase == 2 emits interaction.contact_belly.touch once
- entering Phase 3 while this Contact still owns the interaction emits interaction.contact_belly.stroke once
- Phase 1 exits and Phase 3+ exits do not emit a touch event
- ending in Phase 3 emits interaction.contact_belly.stroke.cancel; reply_to is this interaction's stroke.EventId; submitted/rejected both continue cleanup"

Content.value:
"# Contact Thigh
Phase-free contact placeholder. Capsule receivers cover Left/Right Upper Leg. Submits ThighPoke via InteractionExpression.

WarudoDC Contact settlement:
- commits [600, 2000] before acquiring InteractionOwner
- ending while Phase == 2 emits interaction.contact_thigh.touch once
- entering Phase 3 while this Contact still owns the interaction emits interaction.contact_thigh.stroke once
- Phase 1 exits and Phase 3+ exits do not emit a touch event
- ending in Phase 3 emits interaction.contact_thigh.stroke.cancel; reply_to is this interaction's stroke.EventId; submitted/rejected both continue cleanup"

Content.value:
"# Contact Leg
Phase-free contact placeholder. Capsule receivers cover Left/Right Lower Leg. Submits LegPoke via InteractionExpression.

WarudoDC Contact settlement:
- commits [600, 2000] before acquiring InteractionOwner
- ending while Phase == 2 emits interaction.contact_leg.touch once
- entering Phase 3 while this Contact still owns the interaction emits interaction.contact_leg.stroke once
- Phase 1 exits and Phase 3+ exits do not emit a touch event
- ending in Phase 3 emits interaction.contact_leg.stroke.cancel; reply_to is this interaction's stroke.EventId; submitted/rejected both continue cleanup"

Content.value:
"# Contact Butt
Phase-free contact placeholder. Left/right rear-side receiver spheres are attached to Hips. Submits ButtPoke via InteractionExpression.

WarudoDC Contact settlement:
- commits [600, 2000] before acquiring InteractionOwner
- ending while Phase == 2 emits interaction.contact_butt.touch once
- entering Phase 3 while this Contact still owns the interaction emits interaction.contact_butt.stroke once
- Phase 1 exits and Phase 3+ exits do not emit a touch event
- ending in Phase 3 emits interaction.contact_butt.stroke.cancel; reply_to is this interaction's stroke.EventId; submitted/rejected both continue cleanup"
